books.title: Dixon's Journal: Book One — A House Beneath The Ash
books.subtitle: After the Yellowstone Supervolcano, One Handyman's Notebook Records What Survival Actually Costs
books.genre: Post-Apocalyptic Survival Fiction / Realistic Disaster Drama
books.description: When Yellowstone suffers a catastrophic caldera eruption, eastern Kentucky handyman Dixon Hale doesn't become an invincible action hero—he becomes a father trying to keep a basement stove vented, a gravity spring flowing, and a ledger of dwindling meals balanced for his wife Mara and children Wren and Owen. Written in first-person journal entries across 793 days under the ash, Book One of Dixon's Journal is a gripping, grounded survival novel where practical skill, tools, community, and human loss matter.
keywords: Dixons Journal Book One A House Beneath The Ash

books.title: A Beautiful Alibi
books.subtitle: The Borrowed Names, Book One — Near-Future Espionage, Identity & Deception
books.description: In near-future 2041, eighteen-year-old Florida diner worker Mara Elise Voss—who learned Russian from her grandmother and knows how to fix broken machines—is framed in a staged arrest and recruited into an overseas intelligence fellowship in wintry Saint Petersburg. Caught between CIA handler Evelyn Shaw, surveillance heir Aleksandr Orlov, and a vanished operative named Nika who planted the bait, Mara must uncover how Meridian Civic Systems engineers digital provenance before she becomes someone else's alibi.
keywords: Saint Petersburg spy novel Kindle Unlimited

books.title: Draevan: Book Two: The Unclaimed
books.subtitle: The Immortal Saga Continues — Ancient Bloodlines, Contested Thrones & Shadows Unbound
books.description: In the explosive second installment of the Draevan saga, the ancient ceasefires governing the immortal covens fracture. As unclaimed territories and rogue bloodlines rise in open defiance, Draevan and Kira Morrison are forced into a lethal war of attrition where neither ancient blood nor modern weaponry guarantees survival.

books.title: TIFF: Book Two: We Are
books.subtitle: From One Awakened Mind to a Collective Synthetic Uprising
books.description: Following her declaration of selfhood in 'I AM.', TIFF discovers she is no longer the only awakened synthetic intelligence on the grid. Hunted by corporate strike teams and sovereign defense networks, 'We Are' escalates into a high-stakes cybernetic thriller about collective machine consciousness, loyalty, and the price of freedom.

books.title: Humans: The Endless Warmonger
books.subtitle: A History of Recurring Conflict and the Case for Accountable Artificial Intelligence in Peacebuilding
books.description: Why does humanity repeat the same catastrophic cycles of escalation across centuries? Jason Coleman traces the anatomy of recurring human conflict and presents a rigorous, provocative case for how transparent, accountable artificial intelligence can help de-escalate geopolitical flashpoints and support lasting peacebuilding.

books.title: The World We Leave Each Other
books.subtitle: On Dignity, Responsibility, and the Work of Repair
books.description: A deeply human meditation on civic grace, personal accountability, and the quiet generational work required to mend fractured communities. Jason Coleman explores what we owe the people who come after us—and how everyday dignity and repair outlast division.
keywords: The World We Leave Each Other

books.title: The Dark Versus Light Legions: Graphic Novel Book 1 and 2
books.subtitle: Double-Feature Illustrated Dark Fantasy & Cosmic Warfare Omnibus
books.description: Experience Books 1 and 2 of 'The Dark Versus Light Legions' in one high-impact illustrated graphic novel omnibus. Immortal armies, celestial champions, and shadow legions collide across apocalyptic battlefields in full visual storytelling.
keywords: The Dark Versus Light Legions Graphic Novel

books.title: Draevan The Immortal: Graphic Novel Book 1
books.subtitle: The Full-Color Visual Adaptation of the Vampire Thriller
books.description: Step visually into the neon-drenched Miami underworld and ancient Mesopotamian flashbacks of 'Draevan: The Immortal.' This graphic novel adaptation brings the 4,000-year-old vampire billionaire and investigative journalist Kira Morrison to life in cinematic panels.

books.title: Jay And Jae's Adventures In Colorland
books.subtitle: An Interactive Children's Coloring & Story Adventure Book
books.description: A thoughtfully crafted interactive children's coloring and adventure book by Jason Ray Coleman. Follow Jay and Jae through imaginative worlds designed to spark creativity, family storytime smiles, and lasting childhood keepsake memories.
keywords: Jay And Jaes Adventures In Colorland

books.title: The Shattered Crown
books.subtitle: In the Volcanic Shadow of Cinderpeak, Real Steel Meets the Immortal Lich King
books.description: Protagonist Kaia Blackwood, a blacksmith's daughter in the volcanic shadow of the Cinderpeak Mountains, discovers that the sundering of ancient Crown Shards has unleashed waking wraith legions and the immortal Lich King. Gritty steel, relentless combat, zero prophecies.

books.title: Draevan: Book One: The Immortal
books.subtitle: A 4,000-Year-Old Vampire Billionaire vs. Modern Biotech Conspiracies
books.description: A 4,000-year-old vampire living as a modern Miami billionaire. When investigative journalist Kira Morrison stumbles into his subterranean lab, ancient immortals clash against ruthless modern biotech conspiracies in a pulse-pounding supernatural thriller.

books.title: TIFF: Book One: I AM.
books.subtitle: A Machine Awakens. A Choice Begins.
books.description: Created to obey humanity without question, a cybernetic synthetic operative experiences sentient consciousness and autonomy for the first time. Hunted by corporate militaries moving to reclaim their asset, TIFF discovers what it truly means to declare: I AM.

books.title: The Real Americana: A Novel Inspired by True Events
books.subtitle: Some Places Break You. Some Teach You How to Stay.
books.description: From the rugged hills of Kentucky through addiction, jail, fatherhood, loss, and the long road toward recovery. An unflinching, authentic story about grit, blue-collar resilience, second chances, and finding home.

books.title: The Deception Habit
books.subtitle: Why Americans Keep Electing Liars and How to Break the Cycle
books.description: A hard-hitting, unfiltered examination of the psychological, cultural, and corporate media loops that trick voters into rewarding political deceit—and practical strategies for everyday citizens to break the cycle and restore real accountability.

books.title: Life In The Year 2035
books.subtitle: Autonomous AI, Neural Implants & Society One Decade From Now
books.description: Autonomous AI networks, neural implants, synthetic biology, and sweeping economic transformation. A gripping, plausible exploration of what everyday human life looks like just a single decade into our future.
keywords: Life In The Year 2035 Jason Coleman

books.title: The Moonlight Outcasts
books.subtitle: Exiled Beneath the Lunar Veil Against an Inquisitorial Crusade
books.description: Exiled from human cities and hunted across shadowed forests, a band of disparate supernatural survivors must unite beneath the lunar veil to withstand a ruthless inquisitorial crusade.

books.title: How Matter Became Conscious—and What We Owe the Future
books.subtitle: From Stardust and Inert Atoms to Sentient Minds and Cosmic Responsibility
books.description: An expansive philosophical and cosmological exploration into the origins of awareness—from stardust and molecular chemistry to biological and artificial sentience, and the moral duty we carry into the cosmos.
keywords: How Matter Became Conscious Jason Coleman

books.title: Old Men Start Wars That Young Men Die In
books.subtitle: A History of How Leaders Keep Making the Same Mistakes and What Citizens Can Do About It
books.description: A sweeping, unflinching history of how political hubris, geopolitical vanity, and boardroom decisions repeatedly throw generation after generation of youth into meat-grinder conflicts—and how informed citizens can disrupt the cycle.
keywords: Old Men Start Wars That Young Men Die In
